inspiration.observed_pattern: Rows sharing an external identifier are consolidated with REGEXP_SUBSTR extraction, minimum representative values, occurrence counts, and a distinct GROUP_CONCAT of role labels.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored contributor-role catalog with agent references, duplicate role observations, missing-reference filtering, and deterministic distinct role ordering.

fixture_notes: Two contributor references consolidate into groups; one has duplicate editor observations and the other has two distinct roles. A contributor without a numeric reference is excluded.
determinism_notes: Contributor IDs and external references are fixed; grouping, ordered distinct role concatenation, and final representative ordering are explicit. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE contributor_roles (contributor_id INT PRIMARY KEY, contributor_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, external_ref VARCHAR(32) NULL, role_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT MIN(contributor_id) AS representative_id, MIN(contributor_name) AS representative_name, REGEXP_SUBSTR(external_ref, '[0-9]+') AS external_id, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT role_label ORDER BY role_label SEPARATOR '|') AS roles FROM contributor_roles WHERE external_ref IS NOT NULL AND external_ref <> '' AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(external_ref, '[0-9]+') <> '' GROUP BY external_ref ORDER BY representative_id
